title: 第21章 相谈清影诉衷肠第22章 无极天地一气斩
content_zh:
林玄称谢之后，拿着无极剑法的玉简，便离开了藏经阁，回到了天雷峰，这时候已经夜晚了。
稍微吃了一点东西之后，林玄困的眼皮打架，就直接休息了，毕竟已经几天几夜没睡觉，剑体修炼成功，他也算是松了一口气。
......
无极门厉秋雨的秘境内，她正在最高一层亭子上喝茶小憩。
只见此时谢清影匆忙来到这里，一见厉秋雨就说道：“厉姐姐，你怎么能这样，林玄师弟虽然怪了一点，但是人还是不错的。”
厉秋雨知道谢清影说的是什么，笑着说道：
“小妮子这不是你想要的比试吗？而且，你可别小看那林玄，虽然他修为境界都不如你，但是武斗谁输谁赢还不一定。”
听闻此言，谢清影莫名有些自责，貌似是自己上次为了去参加三十六州会提出了让林玄打赢自己才能去的，可是她也没想到，林玄输的后果那么严重。
“我这实力，去了三十六州会只参加武斗不就行了？为什么你们跟父亲一样都那么不看好我！”
谢清影有些赌气的说着，扔出一枚红色的妖兽内丹在桌子上。
厉秋雨一看，美眸微微一凝，诧异道：
“四阶中期妖兽内丹？你突破到天武境界了？”
谢清影拿出四阶中期妖兽内丹，自然是她斩杀四阶中期妖兽之后得到的，也是想说明一下自己的实力！
一般来说，能有这种实力的基本上都是天武境界强者。
“还没有，但是快了，到时候我的实力会更进一阶！难道以我这等实力，还不能去参加那三十六州会吗？”谢清影诉说着自己的心中不满。
厉秋雨闻言摇了摇头，叹息道：“不是不让你去，你也知道，门主如今外出未归，唯一的挂念就是你，如果你去了出了什么事，我们谁能担当得起。”
“可是我不想一直活在他的规划下面！厉姐姐，我已经长大了，再也不是以前那个只会闯祸哭鼻子的小女孩了！我想去看看外面的世界！”谢清影想起以前的自己，颇为哭声说道。
“姐姐是过来人，外面的世界，不去见识也罢。”
厉秋雨仿佛在谢清影身上看到了年轻的自己，叹息说道。
“我们无极门只有一个名额，不过带你去见识一下倒是可以，但是你不能参加那些竞选项目，若被天炎国一些官方组织选中，到时候无法向你父亲交代。”

“好嘞！厉姐姐放心，我也不想去那些地方，我就是想去见识一下三十六州的那些天骄！”谢清影目的达成，展颜一笑。
“你啊......”厉秋雨见谢清影情绪如此多变，摇了摇头，微微淡笑。
“那厉姐姐，后天的擂台比武是不是不用了呀，林玄师弟能在短短时间内有如此实力，想必资质肯定很好！”谢清影知道以自己目前的实力，在无极内年轻一代是无敌的，想着为林玄开解一下擂台祸端。
毕竟输了的话，林玄可是要进入镇狱之地。
“那不行，擂台战已经定好了。擂台战不仅仅是为了探清林玄实力，更是为了树新风，让我们无极内所有弟子看到差距与榜样！”
厉秋雨摇头说着，目光露出一丝坚定道：
“修炼一途，在于争！我们无极门这些年和和乐乐的风气，也要好好改一改了！”
听到这话，谢清影也知道这擂台是无法取消了，但还是劝说道：“那厉姐姐，你能不能把林玄师弟输了的惩罚改一改？”
“谁不知道那镇狱之地，不是人待的地方，进入那地方俩年，人会废的。林玄师弟如此资质，未免太可惜了。”
content_en:
After Lin Xuan thanked him, he took the jade slip of Wuji Sword Technique and left the Scripture Collection Pavilion and returned to Tianlei Peak. It was already night.
After eating a little something, Lin Xuankong's eyelids trembled and he went to rest. After all, he had not slept for several days and nights. He was relieved that he had succeeded in practicing the sword body.
...
In the secret realm of Wuji Sect Li Qiuyu, she was drinking tea and taking a nap on the highest floor pavilion.
Xie Qingying came here in a hurry and said as soon as she saw Li Qiuyu: "Sister Li, how could you do this? Although Junior Brother Lin Xuan is a little strange, he is still a good person."
Li Qiuyu knew what Xie Qingying was talking about and said with a smile:
"Xiao Nizi, isn't this the competition you want? Besides, don't underestimate Lin Xuan. Although his cultivation level is not as good as yours, there is no guarantee who will win in a martial arts fight."
Hearing this, Xie Qingying felt inexplicably guilty. It seemed that she had asked Lin Xuan to win before she could go to the thirty-six states meeting last time, but she did not expect that the consequences of Lin Xuan's defeat would be so serious.
"With my strength, can't I just participate in martial arts when I go to the Thirty-Six States Association? Why do you think so little of me like my father!"
Xie Qingying said angrily and threw a red demonic beast inner elixir on the table.
Li Qiuyu looked at it, her beautiful eyes narrowed slightly, and she said in surprise:
"Mid-level fourth-level monster inner elixir? Have you broken through to the realm of Tianwu?"
Xie Qingying took out the inner elixir of the mid-level fourth-level monster. Naturally, she got it after killing the mid-level fourth-level monster. She also wanted to show her strength!
Generally speaking, those who have this kind of strength are basically those who are strong in the Tianwu realm.
"Not yet, but soon, my strength will be even better by then! With my level of strength, can't I still participate in the Thirty-Six States Conference?" Xie Qingying expressed her dissatisfaction.
Hearing this, Li Qiuyu shook his head and sighed: "It's not that I won't let you go. You also know that the sect master is out and has not returned. His only concern is you. If something happens to you while you are gone, who among us can bear the responsibility."
"But I don't want to live under his plan all the time! Sister Li, I have grown up, and I am no longer the little girl who only got into trouble and cried! I want to see the outside world!" Xie Qingying said in tears, thinking of her former self.
"Sister is someone who has been here before. It's okay not to see the outside world."
Li Qiuyu seemed to see his younger self in Xie Qingying, and sighed.
"We have only one spot in Wuji Sect, but I can take you to see it, but you can't participate in those election projects. If you are selected by some official organizations of Tianyan Kingdom, you won't be able to explain it to your father."
"Okay! Don't worry, sister Li. I don't want to go to those places either. I just want to meet those geniuses from the Thirty-Six Prefectures!" Xie Qingying achieved her goal and smiled.
"You..." Seeing Xie Qingying's changeable mood, Li Qiuyu shook her head and smiled slightly.
"Sister Li, don't we need to compete in the ring the day after tomorrow? Junior Brother Lin Xuan can achieve such strength in such a short period of time, so he must be very qualified!" Xie Qingying knew that with her current strength, the younger generation in Wuji was invincible, and wanted to solve the trouble in the ring for Lin Xuan.
After all, if he loses, Lin Xuan will enter the prison.
"That won't work, the ring battle has been decided. The ring battle is not only to find out Lin Xuan's strength, but also to establish a new trend and let all our disciples in Wuji see the gap and set an example!"
Li Qiuyu shook his head and said with a firm look in his eyes:
"Cultivation is all about competition! Our Wuji Sect's Helele culture over the past few years needs to be changed!"
After hearing this, Xie Qingying also knew that the arena could not be canceled, but she still persuaded him: "Sister Li, can you punish Junior Brother Lin Xuan for losing?"Penalty and change? "
"Who doesn't know that the prison town is not a place for people to stay? If you enter that place for two years, you will become disabled. It would be a pity that Junior Brother Lin Xuan has such qualifications. "
